molecular imaging of tumor response to therapy can be used to identify the most effective targeted agents for individual tumors and that this approach is more effective in identifying the optimal targeted therapy than conventional testing strategies.
molecular imaging can assist drug discovery, development, and clinical use in oncology by providing information about the functional effects of targeted agents.

the use of molecular imaging in oncology drug development.

the development of novel imaging probes and imaging methods to enable the noninvasive assessment of molecular processes in vivo, and with the application of these imaging tools in the context of drug development.
the development of novel imaging agents and the application of these agents in the context of drug development.
